=========================

**Level** 2


We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

**About your team**


GPS Delivery supports a variety of customers, including Retail, Workplace and Institutional investors in the wholesale, direct investing and advised channels.Our team of colleagues are split across many locations worldwide, and we all strive to ensure our customers get the best possible service.

**About your role**

  

GPS technology stack and engineering ecosystem needs to evolve at a fast pace to cater to strategic technology drivers and to meet end customer experience demands. There is need for a seasoned technologist leader who can lead / drive this space with dedicated energy, passion and inspiration. The person in the role will be expected to define appropriate test strategies including various aspects of automation testing for the respective programs/projects, co\-own the test plan. The person is expected have strong understanding and experience of agile delivery and testing practices, to drive high levels of automation and efficiencies, drive adoption of toolsets in line with the organizational direction and connect to the wider delivery and testing community within the organization to share best practices. The person is expected to have a high degree of connect with the external environment to sense market trends on related technologies and practices and help bring innovation and provide thought leadership to the overall department and the wider organization. The key outcomes shall be (but not limited to) to create a culture of automation keeping DevOps principle of speed and quality in mind.  

Candidate would be expected to have exposure to Cloud concepts with respect to testing. The role shall ensure that other tech experts are well guided/mentored, and the work gets delivered as per tech strategy and guidelines. The role is also expected to lead portfolio level initiatives driving efficiency and thought leadership from QA perspective.

* Experience in executing **unit**, **integration**, **functional**, and **regression** testing activities.

* Familiarity with modern software engineering practices, including **Agile methodologies**, **Test\-Driven Development (TDD)**, and the **Test Pyramid**.
* Exposure to **AI\-enabled** **testing**, **development**, or **productivity** tools.
* Ability to understand **business requirements** and translate them into effective **test scenarios** and **test cases**.
* Strong **analytical** and **problem\-solving** skills with attention to detail.
* Effective **verbal** and **written** **communication** skills and the ability to work collaboratively within **cross\-functional** teams.

**Technical Skills**

* Core Java: Working Knowledge

title: SAP Project & Operations Lead
description:
**Purpose of Position:**

The SAP Project \& Operations Lead serves as the primary functional focal point across Project System (PS), Plant Maintenance (PM), Production Planning (PP), and Quality Management (QM) within the Group\-wide SAP S/4HANA environment

The role ensures stable operational processes, supports continuous improvement, leads solution design, and enables best\-practice process adoption across all operating companies.

This position serves as the primary functional authority for operations\-related modules and works closely with business stakeholders, SAP partners, and internal CoE teams to ensure efficient and reliable SAP\-enabled business processes.

The role also provides leadership, mentoring and functional direction to Associate Consultants and contributes to the long\-term enhancement and standardization of SAP operations processes across the Group.

**Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities:**

**SAP Functional Ownership**

1\. Lead functional ownership of PM, PS, PP, and QM modules across the SAP S/4HANA Group instance.

2\. Manage solution architecture and ensure alignment to SAP best practices and business process standards.

3\. Lead Fit\-to\-Standard, solution design, configuration review, and functional specification development.

**Operational Excellence \& Support**

4\. Ensure stable system operations, manage L2/L3 incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, and resolve cross\-functional issues.

5\. Oversee the associate’s daily support work, ensuring timely resolution of operational tickets and adherence to CoE processes.

6\. Monitor integration touchpoints with MM, FICO, HR, Procurement, EHS, and SCM to maintain data and process consistency.

**Enhancements, Change Management, and Optimization**

7\. Identify and lead enhancement initiatives across PM, PS, PP, and QM to improve performance, usability, and compliance.

8\. Develop functional specifications, coordinate with technical teams (ABAP, BTP, Integration), and validate delivered solutions.

9\. Lead the testing lifecycle (SIT/UAT), including developing test scripts, validating results, and ensuring quality assurance.

**Business Engagement \& Governance**

10\. Collaborate with business owners (Operations, Engineering, Projects, Manufacturing, HSE, QA) to analyse pain points and improvement opportunities.

11\. Define and maintain process documentation, SOPs, functional specifications, solution documentation, and training materials.

12\. Ensure compliance with audit requirements, internal controls, change management processes, and system governance.

**Reporting \& Analytics Alignment**

13\. Work closely with the SAP Analytics \& Reporting Consultant to support operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting for operations functions.

14\. Validate data accuracy for operational KPIs across PP, PM, PS, and QM.

**Leadership \& CoE Development**

15\. Guide and mentor the Associate Consultants assigned to operations modules.

16\. Contribute to SAP roadmap discussions and future CoE capability development.

17\. Represent the operations domain in Group SAP governance forums (SteerCo, Change Advisory Board, etc.)

**Principal Challenges:**

1\. Managing complex integration across PM, PS, PP, and QM within a single SAP instance used by multiple companies across the group.

2\. Balancing heavy operational support with enhancement demands and strategic improvement initiatives.

3\. Standardizing processes across operating companies with varying maturity levels.

4\. Ensuring strong change control and avoiding disruption to mission\-critical operations.

5\. Managing cross\-functional dependencies and ensuring alignment between technical and functional teams.

**Minimum Academic \& Professional Qualifications**:

1\. Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or an equivalent field.

2\. SAP S/4HANA certification in PM, PP, or PS is required (multiple certifications are advantageous).

3\. Proven experience with SAP Activate methodology, including fit\-to\-standard analysis, testing cycles, and deployment phases, is required

4\. Strong understanding of manufacturing, maintenance, project management, and quality process cycles.

5\. Additional certifications or learning in process architecture, or solution governance is an advantage

**Minimum Work Experience:** 

1\. 7 to 10 years of hands\-on experience delivering and supporting SAP PM, PS, PP, and QM modules.

2\. Proven experience leading solution design, configuration oversight, testing, and deployment in at least two full\-cycle SAP implementations or major rollout projects (S/4HANA preferred).

3\. Strong track record in stabilizing operations, resolving cross\-module issues, and improving system performance.

4\. Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders and managing functional expectations.

5\. Prior experience guiding junior consultants or support analysts is strongly preferred.

6\. Exposure to SAP BTP integrations, Fiori apps, digital maintenance, and manufacturing execution systems is a plus.

**Skills \& Competencies Required:**

· **Technical \& Functional Skills**

1\. Deep functional expertise in PM, PS, PP, and QM with proven configuration and solution design knowledge.

2\. Strong understanding of cross\-functional processes (MM, FICO, HR, Procurement, and SCM).

3\. Proficiency in defining functional specifications, validating technical development, and coordinating with technical teams.

4\. Strong understanding of S/4HANA master data (materials, equipment, BOM, routing, WBS, work centers).

5\. Experience in troubleshooting performance, integration, and data integrity issues.

6\. Familiarity with process automation, workflow, and enhancement frameworks.

7\. Knowledge of SAP role/authorization framework for operational areas.

· **Soft Skills**

1\. Strong leadership qualities with the ability to mentor and guide an associate.

2\. Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders.

3\. Highly analytical and structured problem\-solving ability.

4\. Strong documentation, process mapping, and presentation skills.

5\. Ability to manage multiple workstreams and prioritize under pressure.

6\. High level of accountability and ownership of module performance.

7\. Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to adopt new SAP innovations.

8\. Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with the ability to break down complex SAP issues.

**QHSSE Responsibilities:**

1\. Comply with all organizational Quality, Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (QHSSE) policies and procedures.

2\. Ensure that all SAP support activities follow documented quality standards and audit requirements.

3\. Proactively identify and report any risks or non\-compliances that may impact system integrity or business operations.

4\. Maintain secure handling of system access, data privacy, and sensitive business information.

5\. Promote a safe and compliant working environment through accountability, awareness, and continuous improvement.

description:
**QA Lead – Automation**
========================

**Experience:** 5\+ Years**Location:** Gurugram**About Fairdeal.Market**
-------------------------


Fairdeal.Market is a fast\-growing B2B quick\-commerce platform transforming how retailers, wholesalers, and manufacturers buy and sell everyday products.
We are building a technology\-driven supply chain that combines commerce, logistics, dark stores, data, and automation to deliver a seamless buying experience for retailers.
As we scale rapidly, we are looking for a **QA Lead – Automation** who can take ownership of our quality engineering function and build scalable, reliable, and efficient automation practices across our products.**Role Overview**
-----------------


As the **QA Lead – Automation**, you will be responsible for driving the overall QA strategy with a strong focus on automation, framework development, test coverage, and release quality.
You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and Business teams to ensure that our applications, APIs, integrations, and critical business workflows are thoroughly tested and production\-ready.
This is a **hands\-on leadership role** where you will be expected to design automation frameworks, write and review automation scripts, improve QA processes, mentor team members, and establish quality standards across the engineering organization.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Automation \& Framework Development**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web and mobile applications.
* Develop automated test cases for critical business workflows and regression suites.
* Identify manual test cases that can be effectively automated.
* Improve automation coverage, execution speed, reliability, and maintainability.
* Conduct code reviews for automation scripts and ensure adherence to coding standards.
* Evaluate and introduce new automation tools and technologies where required.

### **API \& Backend Testing**

* Build and maintain API automation suites.
* Test REST APIs, integrations, backend services, and data flows.
* Validate API responses, business logic, error handling, authentication, and integrations.
* Work closely with backend engineers to identify and resolve quality issues.

### **CI/CD \& Quality Engineering**

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with engineering teams to establish automated quality gates.
* Monitor automation failures and improve test stability.
* Contribute to continuous testing practices across development and deployment cycles.

### **QA Strategy \& Leadership**

* Define and implement the overall QA and automation strategy.
* Own test planning, regression strategy, test coverage, and release quality.
* Establish QA processes, standards, and best practices.
* Define and track QA metrics and automation KPIs.
* Mentor and guide QA engineers and help build a strong quality engineering culture.
* Participate in hiring and evaluation of QA team members.

### **Product \& Release Quality**

* Work closely with Product Managers, Developers, and Engineering Leads to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Identify critical user journeys and ensure adequate test coverage.
* Own QA sign\-off and provide risk\-based recommendations for releases.
* Investigate production issues and drive root\-cause analysis.
* Ensure critical workflows such as catalog, cart, checkout, orders, payments, inventory, pricing, and delivery\-related flows are thoroughly tested.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------

* 6–10 years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience in **test automation**.
* Experience designing or building automation frameworks from scratch.
* Strong experience with tools such as **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium**, or similar.
* Strong programming/scripting experience in **Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript**.
* Strong understanding of API testing and automation.
* Experience with **Postman, Rest Assured**, or equivalent API testing tools.
* Experience integrating automated testing with **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Working knowledge of **Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar tools**.
* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test planning, regression testing, and defect management.
* Experience with Git/version control systems.
* Experience mentoring or leading QA engineers.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience in **e\-commerce, B2B commerce, quick\-commerce, logistics, fintech, or marketplace products**.
* Experience testing high\-volume transactional systems.
* Experience with mobile application testing.
* Knowledge of performance/load testing tools such as JMeter or similar.
* Experience working with cloud environments.
* Basic understanding of SQL and database testing.
* Experience working in fast\-paced startup environments.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

  

* Thinks beyond test cases and focuses on **overall product quality**.
* Is hands\-on with automation and can independently solve complex testing challenges.
* Can build automation frameworks rather than simply execute existing scripts.
* Takes ownership of quality from development to production.
* Can balance speed, quality, and business priorities.
* Has strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Enjoys working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup environment.

**Why Join Fairdeal.Market?**
-----------------------------

* Opportunity to work on a rapidly scaling B2B quick\-commerce platform.
* Build and own QA automation practices from the ground up.
* Work closely with Engineering and Product leadership.
* Solve real\-world problems across commerce, logistics, inventory, and technology.
* High ownership and significant impact on the product and engineering culture.

Work on quality assurance and testing of the Calypso trading platform (v16\+) across Rates, Credit, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and Backoffice. The role involves end\-to\-end functional, regression, UAT, and batch/EOD testing covering trade lifecycle, pricing, market data, settlements, accounting, reporting, and reconciliation. The position will collaborate with BA, development, environment, and operations teams throughout release cycles.

Design, execute, and maintain functional, regression, and UAT test cases for Calypso.


Test trade capture, pricing, lifecycle events, settlements, confirmations, accounting, and backoffice processing.


Validate EOD and scheduled batch processing, including scheduled tasks, engines, jobs, logs, and task status.

Test Fixed Income products such as bonds and repos, including related reporting and reconciliation flows.
